map.基于 FHWA 简化模型，由交通量、车速、重型车比例、距离与地面类型估算等效连续: Estimates the equivalent continuous sound level Leq from traffic volume, speed, heavy vehicle share, distance and ground type using the simplified FHWA model.
map.松软地面（疏松土壤/植被，衰减 -7 dB）: Loose soft ground (loose soil/vegetation, -7 dB attenuation)
map.💡 简化 FHWA 模型：Leq ≈ 10·log₁₀(V) + 0.2·S −: 💡 Simplified FHWA model: Leq ≈ 10·log₁₀(V) + 0.2·S − 10·log₁₀(d) + 40 + ΔHV + Δground. Results are reference estimates; professional software (TNM/CadnaA) is needed for actual assessment.
map.普通办公室/住宅区白天: Ordinary office / residential area in daytime
map.一般道路旁/商场: Beside a normal road / shopping mall
map.高速公路旁/重型车多: Beside a highway / many heavy vehicles
map.极吵，长期损害听力: Extremely loud, damaging hearing over time
map.依据《声环境质量标准》GB 3096：居住区昼间 ≤55dB、夜间 ≤45dB；: Per GB 3096 Environmental Quality Standard for Noise: residential areas ≤55dB in daytime and ≤45dB at night; both sides of major traffic arteries ≤70dB in daytime and ≤55dB at night.
map.按小时交通量、平均车速、重型车比例与受声点距离预测等效连续 A 声级 Leq。: Predicts the equivalent continuous A-weighted sound level Leq from hourly traffic volume, average speed, heavy vehicle share and distance to the receptor.
map.评估道路两侧敏感点（住宅、学校）是否超出声环境标准。: Assess whether sensitive points beside roads (residences, schools) exceed the environmental noise standard.
map.比较限速、限行重型车或设置声屏障前后的噪声改善量。: Compare the noise improvement from speed limits, heavy vehicle restrictions or sound barriers before and after.
map.采用简化 FHWA 模型：基准声级 = 10·log₁₀(V) + 0.2·S: The simplified FHWA model is used: base sound level = 10·log₁₀(V) + 0.2·S − 10·log₁₀(d) + 40 (V is hourly traffic veh/h, S is average speed km/h, d is distance to the receptor m); heavy vehicle correction = 10·log₁₀(1 + 9p) (p is heavy vehicle share as a decimal); Leq = base + heavy vehicle correction + ground attenuation term. Perception grading: <50 dB quiet, 50~60 fairly quiet, 60~70 noisy, 70~80 loud, 80~90 very loud, ≥90 extremely loud.
map.V=1000 veh/h、S=60 km/h、d=30 m、重型车 10%：基准: V=1000 veh/h, S=60 km/h, d=30 m, 10% heavy vehicles: base = 10log₁₀(1000) + 0.2×60 − 10log₁₀(30) + 40 = 30 + 12 − 14.77 + 40 ≈ 67.2 dB; heavy vehicle correction = 10log₁₀(1+0.9) ≈ 2.79 dB; total about 70 dB (before ground attenuation), which is "noisy" and exceeds the 55 dB residential daytime standard.
map.为什么交通量用对数？: Why is traffic volume taken in logarithms?
map.声能量叠加遵循对数规律：车流量翻倍时声能量加倍，声级只增加约 3 dB（10lo: Sound energy superposition follows a logarithmic law: when vehicle flow doubles, sound energy doubles and the sound level rises only about 3 dB (10log₁₀2≈3) rather than doubling. That is why road traffic volume can grow sharply while noise rises only slowly.
map.重型车影响为什么这么大？: Why do heavy vehicles matter so much?
map.重型车单车噪声显著高于小客车，模型中用能量等效因子 9 折算：重型车占 10%: A heavy vehicle's noise is significantly higher than a passenger car's, and the model uses an energy equivalence factor of 9: at 10% heavy vehicles the correction is about +2.8 dB and at 30% about +5.5 dB, so night restrictions on heavy trucks are an effective noise reduction measure.
